dogecoin.text:
This week, #Dogecoin was listed on #Coinbase. Some say it was #ElonMusk 's doing, some say it was the Coinbase listing. Regardless, Dogecoin leapt over 30% in 24hrs on Wednesday.

Dogecoin isn’t going away. After around seven years as a meme crypto, Doge has never been stronger. https://t.co/fKmjPS4SRD
